source_policy.native_type_exclusion_scope: Only the native Type channel of the uniquely parsed, extraction-agreeing source declaration. Other mechanisms stay open.
source_policy.recipe_scope: Positive direct input/keep tokens only. Group expansion, result relations and missing index entries are not negatives.
source_policy.moveable_scope: Positive static addToolDefinition literals with original parseItemTypes aliases and original Tags. No missing-membership exclusion.
source_policy.field_scope: EvolvedRecipe nonempty opens cooking questions; absence is not negative. Runtime function, effect and acquisition are never generated.
source_policy.content_basis: ISInventoryPaneContextMenu: native branches around Food/CantEat, HandWeapon, InventoryContainer, Literature, Clothing and DrainableComboItem; evolved cooking handlers distinguish input state. These source consumers motivate questions, not accepted terminal facts.

Rule/anchor inventory only; not treated as validated item predicate or source completeness.
unused_candidates.Iris/input/fixing_fixers.json: Abbreviated IDs do not provide original fixing provenance; covered by open direct/world-work and gap questions.
unused_candidates.Iris/input/moveables_tooldefs.json: Raw Lua definitions and alias/tag semantics are consumed directly instead of treating this abbreviated extraction as authoritative.

admission.change_policy: Explicit revision and affected-source/profile reevaluation; evaluate all targets for affected profiles unless a safe subset is evidenced. No repeated seal ceremony.

Drainable is a use-amount question, not a universal fuel/energy fact; direct function and acquisition remain distinct.
